question: Which of the following is Nitromethane?
solution:
The correct answer is__** CH3NO2.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nitromethane, sometimes shortened to** simply "nitro",** is an organic compound with the **chemical formula CH3NO2.**__
 
• It is the simplest** organic nitro compound.**
 
• It is a **polar liquid commonly used as a solvent** in a variety of industrial applications such as in extractions, as a reaction medium, and as a cleaning solvent.
 
• As an intermediate in **organic synthesis**, it is used widely in the** manufacture of pesticides, explosives, fibers, and coatings**

** Other Uses:-**

__
 
• The principal use of nitromethane is as a **stabilizer for chlorinated solvents**, which are used in** dry cleaning, semiconductor processing**, and degreasing.
 
• It is also used most** effectively as a solvent or dissolving agent for acrylate monomers,** such as cyanoacrylates (more commonly known as "super-glues").
 
• It is also used as **fuel in some forms of racing.**
 
• It can be used as **an explosive when gelled with several percent of gelling agents.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
 

 **CH3N2O5**
 
 
 
• Nitric acid nitromethyl ester
 
 
 
 

 **CH3NH3**
 
 
 
• CH3NH2 is named methyl amine.
 
• This colorless gas is a derivative of ammonia, but with one hydrogen atom being replaced by a methyl group.
 
 
 
 

 **CH3NO3**
 
 
 
• Methyl nitrate is the methyl ester of nitric acid and has the chemical formula CH₃NO₃.
 
• It is a colourless explosive volatile liquid.
